role: Declares the lakes group's table lookup (WorldGenLakes, WorldGenBigMushroom, WorldGenDesertWells, WorldGenIceSpike, WorldGenIcePath rows) and two shared helpers: the biome at a column and BiomeGenBase.getFloatTemperature.
notes: biome_at and biome_temperature are also used by fire.c, randomtick.c, servertick.c, render_blocks.c and world.c (the server tick's ice, snow and lightning branches).
